Run the bcwsft R port over a VRI sf and attach the assigned FBP fuel type

Source: R/fuel_typing.R
run_bcwsft_fuel_typing.Rd

Run the bcwsft R port over a VRI sf and attach the assigned FBP fuel type

Usage

run_bcwsft_fuel_typing(vri, season = "growing", current_year = NULL)

Arguments

vri

sf of VRI polygons (from get_vri_for_fuel_typing()).

season

"growing" or "dormant".

current_year

Integer reference year (defaults to the current year).

Value

vri with added FUEL_TYPE_CD (factor, normalised to the provincial vocabulary via normalize_fbp_codes()) and bcwsft_branch columns.

See also

Other BC fire and fuel data: calc_recently_disturbed(), clip_nfdb_to_study_area(), compare_fuel_typing(), fuel_types_distribution(), get_fuel_types(), get_vri_for_fuel_typing(), load_nbac_polys(), load_nfdb_points(), load_nfdb_polys(), normalize_fbp_codes(), plot_fuel_typing_comparison(), prep_fuel_types_rast()
